_comment: Backend reference for the iobroker-plugin skills. Two supported backends — uncomment the one you run. Skills are written backend-agnostically (see docs/tool-mapping.md); they describe the goal and name tools from BOTH backends as examples.
_comment_backend_a: Backend A — McCavity/iobroker-mcp (FastMCP wrapper around the SimpleAPI adapter, stdio). Path-launched via a venv python + server.py; credentials live in a .env next to server.py. Set IOBROKER_MCP_PYTHON + IOBROKER_MCP_SERVER to absolute paths.
_comment_backend_b: Backend B — official ioBroker/ioBroker.mcp adapter (GermanBluefox, Streamable HTTP/SSE at /mcp). Replace the mcpServers block above with an HTTP transport pointing at your adapter, e.g.: { "iobroker": { "type": "http", "url": "http://<host>:<port>/mcp" } }. As of 2026-06 this adapter is experimental (v0.1.4, not yet on npm) — track before migrating.
